violations.reason: The planned implementations in PR #1820 and PR #1821 completely omit core client brief requirements, specifically automatic access control to closed strains/analytical reports based on Moodle departments, and resilience to external LMS failures (autonomous fallback).

PR #1822 issued an 'approve' verdict for PR #1821 despite PR #1821 omitting core client brief requirements. This violates BARCAN-TAG-00's refusal criteria, which requires that an APPROVE decision is strictly binary and only given when all criteria are met.
